title: Mux Protocol Contract Addresses
description: Per-network contract address configuration for Mux Protocol Soroban contracts. Mainnet entries require an explicit review marker before merge (see _review). Empty strings are valid placeholders for contracts not yet deployed to a given network.

_review.description: Mainnet address PR review rule. Any change to a mainnet entry MUST be reviewed and approved before merge. The marker is intentionally separate from the address values so that editing an address without updating the marker is detected.

mainnetApproval.description: Review token set by CI/maintainer when mainnet address change is approved. Must be null when no mainnet address has changed.

mainnetApprovals.description: Map of address key to approved value, updated when a mainnet address change is approved.

errorCodes.description: Stable error codes emitted when the review rule is violated.

contractAddress.description: Soroban contract address (C... Strkey) or empty string if not yet deployed.

networkAddresses.description: Contract addresses for a single Stellar network.

muxAccountFactory.description: mux-account-factory: factory for deploying account instances.

muxRecovery.description: mux-recovery: guardian-initiated account recovery with timelock.

muxRegistry.description: mux-registry: contract version and metadata registry.
